For an m by n matrix, rank is the number of pivots, nullity is n minus rank, and row rank equals column rank.

items.text: The displayed rank-nullity formula assumes a linear map with finite-dimensional domain V.
Matrix rank is unchanged by elementary row operations, but the actual column space in the original ambient coordinates is not.
For A in F^(m by n), nullity counts free variables in Ax=0 and is n-rank(A).
